laws.rule: Parque Nacional Volcán Isluga: Plan fuel and food supplies before travelling to this remote park; the operator advises precautions against altitude sickness above 4,000 metres. This is advice, not an entry permit. The named unit prohibits fires and other heat sources, pets or exotic animals, leaving enabled trails and removing natural resources. Follow ranger instructions; no region-wide extension is made.

items.text: Parque Nacional Volcán Isluga: CONAF's own unit page prohibits consuming alcoholic drinks. This is the named protected-area condition, not an alcohol ban throughout the region.
